en: A vintage postcard featuring a black-and-white photograph of a grand building and a landscaped esplanade in a European town, with wooded hills in the background. The image side is labeled 'Folkbanken, Esplanaden och norra stadsberget' and 'Sundsvall den 40/1906.' The postcard is adorned with handwritten script above and below the image. The reverse side shows Swedish text, a printed decorative border, a green Swedish stamp, and is addressed to a recipient on 'Sundsgatan' in 'Wänersborg.'
